name: asimov-mcp
description: Search the ThinkRobotics electronics and robotics catalogue from your project: specs, live price and stock in INR, store policies, parts lists with a buy link, and your own orders and support tickets after sign-in.

interface.shortDescription: Find, check and source robotics parts
interface.longDescription: Search the thinkrobotics.com catalogue, read specs, check live price and stock in INR, get store policies quoted from the store, and turn a project into a parts list with a buy link. Sign in with your store email to look up your orders and support tickets.
defaultPrompt: Find an in-stock motor driver for two 12 V DC motors under 500 rupees.
Read this project and build a ThinkRobotics parts list for it.
What is the ThinkRobotics return policy?
